about: The Art of Nations catalogue: every painting and book shown (origins: the artist’s founding works, shown before the nation portraits and not counted among the 195) on the Art of Nations page (perfectnations.org/art-of-nations/). The Art of Nations Steward keeps this file. tools/build_art.py turns it into pages/art-of-nations.html. Write copy in plain words with curly apostrophes and no contractions; the build turns every non-ASCII character into an HTML entity. Every image URL must already exist in the Media Library; list the 300, 600 and 768 px copies WordPress makes under images (the page never loads more than 768 px until a visitor opens the viewer); zoom is the copy the viewer opens, at most about 1 MB.
shop_note: When the Shopify store opens, put its address in shop and a buy_url (and, if wanted, a price such as "$2,500") on each work. Works with a buy_url show a Buy button beside Enquire; works without one stay by enquiry.

origins.title: Botanical Origins
origins.statement: The garden painting from which the Art of Nations grew. Its fern, dotted leaves, coral flowers and red feather run through the nation portraits in Perfect Nations.
origins.alt: Botanical Origins by Preeti Sinha: a garden painted in ochre, sky blue, coral and cobalt, with a sweeping green fern, dotted leaves, coral flowers, striped seed pods, a red feather and a yellow bowl
origins.note: Uploaded 7 Nov 2026 (Media Library 17752) from assets/style/pn-portrait-style-reference.jpg. Acrylic on canvas, 12 x 18 in, painted in 2026, not for sale (the artist, 7 Nov 2026).

paintings.title: Hindu Kush in Bloom
paintings.statement: The Hindu Kush rises as a flame-shaped bloom in the flag’s black, red and green.
paintings.alt: Hindu Kush in Bloom: the Afghan mountains redrawn as a radiant flowering peak in black, red and green, with a pomegranate trailing beside it
paintings.spec: One of one · Acrylic on canvas · 24 × 24 in · signed

paintings.title: The Trident in Bloom
paintings.statement: Where the old flag breaks, this one begins again, in ultramarine and gold.
paintings.alt: The Trident in Bloom: the broken trident of Barbados opening into a botanical bloom in ultramarine and gold, with sugarcane trailing beside it
paintings.spec: One of one · Acrylic on canvas · 24 × 24 in · signed

paintings.title: Mount Kenya in Bloom
paintings.statement: The mountain that names the nation flowers in black, red, green and white.
paintings.alt: Mount Kenya in Bloom: the snow peak of Mount Kenya redrawn as a radiant flowering summit in black, red, green and white
paintings.spec: One of one · Acrylic on canvas · 24 × 24 in · signed
paintings.note: The photograph is portrait (1122 x 1402) while the canvas is 24 x 24 in, so the square frame crops it. Upload a square photograph of the canvas to show the whole work.

paintings.title: The Thousand Hills in Bloom
paintings.statement: A thousand hills unfold as a flowering wave in blue, yellow and green.
paintings.alt: The Thousand Hills in Bloom: the rolling hills of Rwanda redrawn as a radiant flowering wave in blue, yellow and green
paintings.spec: One of one · Acrylic on canvas · 24 × 24 in · signed
paintings.note: The full upload is 9.3 MB; the page never uses it. The photograph is portrait while the canvas is 24 x 24 in, so the square frame crops it. A square version exists (Thousand-Hills-in-Bloom-Rwanda.png, 2048 x 2048): confirm which is the canvas.

books.title: Perfect Kenya
books.copy: From the heat beneath the Rift to the promise of a decent life: mountains and grasslands, farms and cities, and a coast shaped by the Indian Ocean.
